channel.title: DailyBite: Daily Healthy Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified healthy food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Top Pick: Panera: $4.99 Mix & Match Value Menu
item.description: Half- and cup-sized portions of soups, salads, and sandwiches from a 10-item menu for $4.99 each, and every item comes with a free side (baguette, chips, or apple). Pair any two for a full meal under $10 - in cafes and online, no membership needed. (Ongoing)

item.title: Top Pick: Qdoba: Free Guacamole and Queso with Any Entree
item.guid: Qdoba-Free Guacamole and Queso with Any Entree-2026-09-05
item.description: Order any full-size entree through the Qdoba app or website and add hand-crafted guacamole and 3-cheese queso at no extra charge, no points required. (Ongoing)

item.title: Top Pick: Chick-fil-A: Free Breakfast Entree Weekly
item.description: Chick-fil-A One app members at participating Los Angeles metro locations get one free breakfast entree per week, including grilled chicken options, through November 9. (Los Angeles metro only only) (Through November 9, 2026)

item.title: Chili's: 3 For Me Meal from $10.99
item.description: Pick a non-alcoholic drink, a starter, and a full entree for one flat price, available all day every day at participating Chili's locations. (Ongoing)

item.title: Subway: Sub of the Day for $4.99, Protein Pockets and Deli Faves from $3.99
item.guid: Subway-Sub of the Day for $4.99, Protein Pocket-2026-09-05
item.description: Subway's standing Fresh Value Menu features a different discounted 6 inch sub each day plus permanent $3.99 Protein Pockets and Deli Faves options. (Ongoing)

item.title: El Pollo Loco: $5 Fire-Grilled Combos: Rotating Value Menu
item.guid: El Pollo Loco-$5 Fire-Grilled Combos: Rotating Value M-2026-09-05
item.description: A rotating lineup of roughly $5 combos (Original Pollo Bowl, Classic Chicken Burrito, taquitos and more) built on citrus-marinated fire-grilled chicken, every day at participating locations. Lineup and pricing vary by market. (West & Southwest only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Chipotle: $0 Delivery Fee on Pollo Asado Orders
item.guid: Chipotle-$0 Delivery Fee on Pollo Asado Orders-2026-09-05
item.description: Order the returning Pollo Asado through the Chipotle app, Chipotle.com, or Chipotle.ca and delivery fees are waived through September 13. (Through September 13, 2026)

item.title: Subway: Sub of the Day 6-inch for $4.99
item.description: Subway's Fresh Value Menu features a different discounted 6-inch sub every day, all day, at participating U.S. restaurants. (Ongoing)

item.title: Subway: Protein Pockets for $3.99
item.description: Subway's Fresh Value Menu includes protein-packed pocket sandwiches with over 20 grams of protein, priced at $3.99 at participating locations. (Ongoing)

item.title: Qdoba: $2 Off Orders with New Queso Fundido
item.guid: Qdoba-$2 Off Orders with New Queso Fundido-2026-09-05
item.description: Get $2 off digital app or website orders that include the new Queso Fundido dip using code FUNDIDO as part of Qdoba's Diptember kickoff. (Through September 6, 2026)
